mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate relative to its 6-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 4.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS increase, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During the post-pandemic recovery regime, rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals expanding manufacturing output that boosts corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth > 0.5% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases corporate borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a tightening labor market that elevates consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or interaction term Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a housing market boom regime, rising housing starts (HOUST) signal strong residential construction activity that stimulates consumer confidence and corporate revenue growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST growth > 1.0% in 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output that increases corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO trends upward, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.
